Zero stale 'Dispatch OS' / 'Dispatch.RR' strings found across Login, Sidebar, Dashboard, Loads, Invoices, AI Assistant, and Dispatch Board pages after a frontend restart. All new endpoints (/api/, /api/assumptions, /api/loads/analyze, /api/compliance) and new UI screens (/analyze, /compliance, Settings theme+assumptions) verified end-to-end.

POST /api/loads/analyze {rate:2400, loaded:900, dh:80, Solo} -> decision='Book', risk='Green', net_profit>0, target_rate>min_acceptable>0
POST /api/loads/analyze {rate:800, loaded:900, dh:200} -> decision in (Reject,Negotiate) risk in (Red,Yellow)

Topbar theme-toggle-btn cycles theme + persists to localStorage 'metaphora_theme'
Settings theme cards theme-auto/light/dark switch <html> class in real time

/analyze: fill broker/rate/loaded/deadhead + ma-analyze-btn -> BOOK decision badge, reasoning, all financial labels (Fuel Cost, Driver Pay, Net Profit, Margin %, Deadhead %, Target Rate, Minimum Acceptable) render
ma-book-btn creates a new load (verified via /api/loads count 15 -> 16)
/compliance shows all 4 KPIs (green=2, yellow=7, red=9, blocked=9); status='red' filter narrows list to 9 cards
Regression: /, /loads, /invoices, /ai, /board all render with content and no stale brand strings
action_items: Non-blocking: The preview served an outdated bundled index.html with old title 'AI Dispatch.RR — Trucking Control Tower' until frontend supervisor was restarted. After 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend', title correctly served as 'Metaphora Control Tower — AI Operating System for Freight Operations'. Root cause: stale CRA dev bundle. Consider adding a build/version cache-bust step for future preview deploys.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~970 lines and mixes models, auth, CRUD, integrations, seed, analytics, and AI in one file - should be split into modules (auth.py, models.py, routers/{trucks,drivers,loads,compliance,ai}.py, seed.py) once feature set stabilizes.
Compliance & analyze logic hard-codes 'insurance amortize per 5 trips/wk' - fine as MVP, but expose as a tunable in assumptions later.
AI /api/ai/chat still returns fallback due to LLM budget exhausted (expected per task note).
Cost assumptions endpoint accepts arbitrary dict (no Pydantic model) - low risk but consider a Pydantic Assumptions model for input validation.
Frontend /public/index.html title updates require supervisor restart to reflect - noted above.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed?force=true executed once via test fixture; produces 8 trucks, 10 drivers, 15 loads with mixed Green/Yellow/Red compliance
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand + Metaphora Control Tower feature expansion is fully verified. All new endpoints/UIs pass. If preview shows old title again, restart frontend supervisor. Book Load flow bumps /api/loads count by exactly 1. Cost assumptions are stored in db.assumptions with id='default'.
